verdict.rationale: Oyster is an EOR and global payroll platform, so a retirement-plan offering with payroll-synced contributions is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only shows generic benefits provisioning and multi-country payroll. Nothing mentions a 401(k) or retirement plan, or contributions that sync automatically with each payroll run. Generic benefits endpoints are an adjacent capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll
